description: Full-text search across the community (members, spaces, posts, …). Provide a `query` term; results come back grouped by entity type, each hit with id, title, subtitle, content, url, and entityId. Bettermode GraphQL query: search.

limit.description: Client-side cap on the number of hits per entity group (the SearchInput type has no server-side limit field).

name: bettermode_search
title: Search
